pick.name: MoSPI eSankhyiki MCP server
pick.what: Official Indian statistics (PLFS, CPI, WPI, IIP, NAS, HCES, NFHS, RBI, Economic Census, NSS rounds) queryable by Claude via MCP
pick.why: Government source, free, and Claude Code can query it directly instead of you downloading PDFs.
pick.free_limits: Free public beta (launched 6 Feb 2026); README lists 31 datasets
pick.maintained: repo active (103 commits; no release tags)
pick.install: claude mcp add esankhyiki-mcp --transport http https://mcp.mospi.gov.in/

alts.name: TRAI performance indicator reports
alts.why: Best source for India internet/mobile reach numbers; Apr-Jun 2026 report released 12 Oct 2026.

alts.name: Tracxn Lite
alts.why: Best free view of who is funded in your space in India.
alts.free_limits: Free Lite with unspecified usage limits, no exports/alerts

candidates.name: data.gov.in (OGD)
candidates.verdict: free datasets/API; site blocked our fetcher, verify

candidates.name: NPCI UPI statistics
candidates.verdict: free monthly UPI volumes; page did not render for us

decision: Official data via the MoSPI MCP lets Claude size Indian markets from primary statistics. Add TRAI/NPCI for digital adoption and Tracxn Lite for competitors; pay for Statista/CMIE only for investor-grade decks.

verify.note: README confirms server URL https://mcp.mospi.gov.in/, command `claude mcp add esankhyiki-mcp --transport http https://mcp.mospi.gov.in/`, MIT, 31 datasets, 103 commits, tools list_datasets/get_indicators/get_metadata/get_data. 6 Feb 2026 launch date not confirmed (search budget exhausted).
